_note: Stage is derived from day. Re-cut 2026-10-30 to the heartbeat plan B (script/notes/心跳节奏表.md in the nottoday repo): six cycles of three days; stage 2 merged into 3; stage 5 from day 13 and never changes after. Code must read this table, never hardcode.

cycles._note: Six cycles of three days. ring = how far the daytime corruption has spread, from what the player stares at outward. Rendering opens one more layer per ring.

calmDaytime._note: Daytime presentation only is rendered as stage 0 on these days. Night beats and the mechanical stage are untouched.

tenderDay._note: Day 14: the new world is kindest to the player while the room is already collapsing. Mechanical stage stays 5. Chat affinity gained this day is multiplied by constants.tenderDayAffinityMultiplier.

dreamNights._note: Three dreams, each a plot step and one more step of screen resolution for every object. 5 = origin (1997, how the player cared for the chick). 11 = mechanism (the office's last day: everyone already replaced, politely, by saying yes). 15 = it (Kuro admits it was in the first two dreams).

nightBeat._note: Every calm ends with a jolt. The night beat (bedtime or dream) is never calm and always runs one ring ahead of the daytime ring. Types rotate so nights do not become predictable.

weather._note: author 2026-11-02: it does not rain every day
